newsitem.title: USA: BEFORE THE BELL - Intel, ITT rise.
newsitem.headline: BEFORE THE BELL - Intel, ITT rise.

text.p: Intel Corp and ITT Corp rose in pre-open trade Wednesday, and Eastman Kodak Co fell, weighed by earnings that were short of expectations, traders said.

Intel was trading at 84-3/4, up from a Tuesday close of 80-29/32. After the markets close Tuesday, the company reported second-quarter earnings of $0.92 a share, above a First Call consensus estimate of $0.90.
Intel stock had risen to 83 in after-hours trading.
ITT was trading at 66 from a close of 62-10/16. It said early Wednesday it would split into three companies to fend off a takeover bid by Hilton Hotels Corp.
ITT also said it would buy back 30 million of its common shares at $70 each. The shares earlier had hit 65-1/4.
Hilton was not trading, a trader said.
Eastman Kodak was trading at 69-7/8 from a closing price of 76-14/16. The company reported second-quarter earnings of $1.12 a share, below the Wall Street consensus of $1.39.
